name: changesafe
description: Gate AI-proposed infrastructure changes from the terminal or CI: deterministic policies, honest exit codes, hashed receipts. The gate itself never calls a model.
//: No `dependencies` on purpose: dist/changesafe.js is one esbuild bundle whose only imports are node: builtins. The workspace packages and zod below are build-time inputs — listing them as dependencies would make npm fetch unpublished @changesafe/* from the registry and install code the bundle already contains.
